plans.idea: Faithful centered stack like the original: the logo crowns the top, the bag is large in the middle, then the headline, then the CTA, with legal tucked into a footer, so it stays unmistakably the same design but uses the extra height.

Headline-led poster on one centre axis: a small brand mark, then a big two-line headline, the product as the visual payoff, and the CTA beneath it, so the eye moves brand to headline to product to action.

Editorial two-column split: a tall product shot fills the left half and the headline and CTA stack flush-left in the right column, with the logo top-left and a full-width legal footer anchoring the bottom.
